nom: Estée Lauder Perfectly Clean Multi-Action Foam Cleanser + Purifying Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report it works well, keeps oiliness in check without a strong smell, and one uses it successfully for oily-combination skin during pregnancy-related dryness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it cleans without over-drying or leaves skin soft and hydrated, while others report it as super drying, leaving residue or a stripped, tight feeling.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or oily-combination skin consistently describe it as effective at cleaning without stripping, working well for both oily and dry zones.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly say it doesn't irritate and is gentle despite fragrance, though one with fragrance-sensitive, delicate skin found it too harsh and burning.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal skin report it leaves skin soft, clean and healthy, and one notes it adapts well to seasonal changes between oily and dry.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention being middle-aged or older (mid-50s) report it cleans without drying, works well for aging skin, and leaves it smoother.

concerns.aging: Reviewers dealing with aging or mature skin report it cleans gently without stripping and leaves skin looking smoother; one middle-aged and one 55-year-old reviewer are satisfied long-term users.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it cleanses without leaving skin dry or tight, some noting it leaves skin hydrated or supple; however, several others report it as very drying, leaving skin feeling stripped, tight, or flaky.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive, fragrance-reactive skin reports a burning sensation after rinsing and describes the product as too harsh for delicate skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer felt the product left a residue and didn't feel truly clean, while others with normal-to-combination skin report no stripping or compromise of skin feel.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the product helped shrink and clear congested, clogged pores on cheeks and nose over time.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: some say it helped reduce acne breakouts around the chin and cheeks and never broke them out, while three others report new breakouts, including one describing a severe breakout and one describing skin turning waxy before breaking out.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin say it manages oil well and keeps skin balanced without a greasy feel, with no complaints of increased oiliness reported.

aspects.libelle: Stings or burns if it contacts eyes

extraits.titre: I feel this cleanser is too harsh for delicate skin
extraits.texte: I tried this cleanser because I use several Estee Lauder products that I really like. This cleanser however, has a very strong fragrance. I usually don't mind a slight fragrance in my cleansers, but this is simply too strong. Like, way too strong! It also burns the absolute heck out of my eyes if it gets near them. My eyes aren't too sensitive if a gentle cleanser accidentally gets in them, but this product burns like no other! I do like the feel of cleanliness it delivers and it makes my skin feel squeaky clean. Bottom line, if you can stand a cleanser with a bottle of perfume dumped into it and don't mind pouring alcohol in your eyes, then this cleanser is for you!

This was my very first ever high end skin care purchase. I brought this when I was a teenager. That time I had oily skin. this product worked amazing to clean my face. I wore makeup back then and i always felt like it removed my left over makeup that is not visible to the eye. Now as a adult I have dry skin. still use this! this is a all skin type product for sure! It cleans my face without over drying it which I LOVE!

I got a sample of this from my mom, and I loved it so much I splurged on the full size one. I have pretty dry skin and this is the only cleanser that leaves my skin feeling clean, fresh, and doesn't dry it out. It's so soft to use, I find it almost therapeutic.

Finally solved an ongoing issue. My pores have been congested on my cheeks and clogged with whiteheads on my nose. I've been trying everything. This facial wash twice a day with a brush is definitely shrinking my pores. I also use night repair serum and vit c and a good moisturizer. I'm drinking plenty of fluids too.

I received this product as a gift with purchase. The smell is light and smells clean. I was surprised it's scented bc I usually use unscented face washes, but the smell isn't overwhelming. it can be used as a foaming wash or mask. I usually leave it on for a mask, and then suds it out when I wash it off. This has really helped out with my acne breakouts around my chin and cheeks. This product will easily compliment any skincare routine.
this made my skin feel weird and waxy. about a week into using it my face broke out severly.

extraits.titre: Estée Lauder's perfectly clean foam face wash is WONDERFUL!
extraits.texte: I LOVE THIS Perfectly Clean foam face wash! I'm 55yrs old and believe me, I've used every face wash known to woman! I use to use another face wash but they stopped making it! Then I found this one. I love everything about this face wash! It removes my makeup, cleans my face without drying it out and I love the way it smells! Yes, I know it's a bit expensive, however it's worth every penny and a small amount goes a long way! So it last a lot longer than the cheaper face washes! TRY IT! YOU WILL LOVE IT! Especially ladies My age!
